title: Secret Story
tagline: French adaptation of the Big Brother franchise's format
synopsis: The game contestants are cut off from the rest of the world during ten to fifteen weeks in a house called “house of secrets”, where every room is fitted with video cameras, except the restroom. The goal is to keep a secret while trying to discover the other contestants' secret.
